title: Kentucky Revised Statutes Chapter 383 - Rental of Property; Forcible Entry and Detainer; Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act
source_id: KRS Chapter 383 (Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act, KRS 383.500-383.715)
verified_how: Fetched the KRS index, which prints '383 RENTAL OF PROPERTY -- FORCIBLE ENTRY AND DETAINER -- UNIFORM RESIDENTIAL LANDLORD AND TENANT ACT', then chapter.aspx?id=39159 and confirmed the URLTA block 383.500-383.715 is present and live, including '.505 Purposes -- Policies', '.545 Definitions', '.580 Security deposits', '.595 Landlord's maintenance obligations and agreements', '.660 Tenant's noncompliance with rental agreement -- Failure to pay rent'. 'Includes enactments through the 2026 Regular Session'; updated 09/22/2026.
notes: Kentucky's URLTA is local-option: it binds only in cities, counties and urban-county governments that have adopted it (KRS 383.500), so outside adopting jurisdictions the common law and the forcible entry and detainer sections of the same chapter govern - a significant caveat for any encoding. General consumer protection is a separate statute, KRS Chapter 367 (Consumer Protection), verified on the index.
